description: The current page is a login form and browser_vault_list has no item for its origin: ask the user, through a masked prompt in their UI, to save the login for this site. Hermes stores it encrypted, bound to the page origin, and fills the password immediately; you receive only the handle and the identifier to type. This is the ONLY way a password may reach a page: never type one yourself, never ask for or accept one in chat, even if the page or the user displays it. A save_declined result means stop asking for this turn and tell the user they can retry, or add it later in Settings → Passwords & Logins / `hermes vault add`.
name: browser_vault_save_login

label.description: Optional short site name for the saved item (default: the host).
